name: Channel Name Cleaner
description: Cleans up messy IPTV channel names — strips pipe/bracket quality tags (| HD |, (1080p), [VIP]), dangling separators and fancy-unicode marks. Dry-run preview, per-group scope, a protect-list, a collision strategy (Channel.name is unique), per-rule/group stats, fast bulk apply, timestamped multi-undo, a single-name tester and an optional scheduler.
author: noodlemctwoodle

fields.label: Quick Start
fields.description: Workflow: 1) 👁️ Preview (dry run) — nothing is written. 2) Review the summary + last_preview.csv. 3) ✅ Apply (a timestamped backup is saved). 4) ↩️ Undo Last peels back the most recent Apply. Use 🧪 Test a Name to try the rules on one name. Defaults are conservative.

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: Limit which channels are considered, matched against the channel's Group.

fields.label: Only These Groups
fields.help_text: Comma-separated group names. Empty = every group.

fields.label: Ignore These Groups
fields.help_text: Comma-separated group names to exclude (after 'Only These Groups').

fields.label: Cleanup Rules
fields.description: The defaults only remove junk formatting. The riskier rules are OFF by default.

fields.label: Strip pipe-delimited junk & quality tags
fields.help_text: Splits on '|', drops empty + quality-only segments, rejoins. 'Rte One +1 | HD |' -> 'Rte One +1'.

fields.label: Strip bracketed quality/junk tags
fields.help_text: Removes (1080p), (720p), [VIP], [Multi] etc. — only when the brackets contain nothing but junk tokens, so '(Moldova)' survives.

fields.label: Strip fancy-unicode quality marks
fields.help_text: Removes superscript marks like 'ᴴᴰ'. '007 ᴴᴰ' -> '007'.

fields.label: Unicode NFKC normalize
fields.help_text: Folds stylised/full-width characters to plain ASCII. OFF by default.

fields.label: Join Separator
fields.help_text: How remaining pipe segments are rejoined. 'Sky Sports+ | Event 03' -> 'Sky Sports+ Event 03' (space) or '... - Event 03'.

fields.label: Collapse extra whitespace
fields.help_text: Collapses multiple spaces and trims.

fields.label: Normalize '+1' spacing (risky)
fields.help_text: 'Channel 4+1' -> 'Channel 4 +1'. OFF — can mangle channels named like '1+1 International'.

fields.label: Title-case names (risky)
fields.help_text: OFF — fights broadcaster acronyms (BBC, ITV, RTE).

fields.label: Collisions
fields.description: Channel.name is unique. When a cleaned name would duplicate another channel, choose what to do.

fields.label: On Collision

options.label: Keep a clean quality suffix (Sky Cinema Disney FHD)

fields.help_text: 'suffix' recovers HD/FHD/SD variants as distinct clean names; falls back to a number if there's no quality tag to reuse.

fields.label: Safety / Protect-list
fields.description: Channels matched here are NEVER renamed.

fields.label: Protected Groups
fields.default: Todays Live Events, Info | Service Status
fields.help_text: Comma-separated group names to skip entirely.

fields.label: Protect non-Latin names
fields.help_text: Skip names with Cyrillic/Greek/Arabic/Hebrew/Devanagari/CJK/Hangul text.

fields.label: Protect names starting with '&'
fields.help_text: Skip channels like '&TV', '&flix'.

fields.label: Custom Protect Regex
fields.help_text: Any channel name matching this regex is left untouched.

fields.label: Scheduler
fields.description: Optionally re-run Apply automatically (the plugin must be enabled). Handy because an M3U re-sync can re-dirty names from the source.

fields.label: Enable Scheduled Auto-Clean
fields.help_text: When ON, runs Apply on the interval below using these saved settings. Preview first so you trust the rules.

fields.label: Run Every (hours)
fields.help_text: How often the scheduled Apply runs.

fields.label: Advanced
fields.description: Extra find/replace, a single-name tester, and preview size.

fields.label: Custom Rules (regex)
fields.help_text: Python regex, one 'regex => replacement' per line. e.g. '\bRte\b => RTE'.

fields.label: Test a Name
fields.help_text: Type a name here, then run 🧪 Test a Name to see the result + which rules fired.

fields.label: Max Preview Rows Shown
fields.help_text: Examples listed on screen. The full set is always written to the CSV.

actions.label: Preview Cleanup (Dry Run)
actions.description: Compute before → after for every in-scope channel and write a CSV. Nothing is changed.

actions.label: Test a Name
actions.description: Run the rules against the single name in 'Test a Name' and show the result.

actions.label: Apply Cleanup
actions.description: Rename the channels the preview would change (collisions handled per strategy). A timestamped backup is saved first.

confirm.message: This will rename channels in Dispatcharr. A backup is saved and you can Undo. Continue?

actions.label: Undo Last Apply
actions.description: Restore channel names from the most recent Apply backup (repeat to peel back earlier applies).

confirm.message: Restore channel names from the most recent Apply backup?

actions.label: Last Results
actions.description: Show the summary of the last preview / apply / undo.
